title: ESQL Compute node throws null reference error on incoming invoices
description: The invoice processing flow in App Connect Enterprise throws a null reference error when processing invoices from a specific supplier. The ESQL script is failing at the point where it reads the 'taxNumber' field from the JSON payload. Other suppliers' invoices process correctly.

worklogs.description: Reproduced the error using a sample invoice JSON from the failing supplier. The 'taxNumber' field is absent from their payload.
Confirmed the ESQL reads taxNumber without a null check: SET OutputRoot.JSON.Data.tax = InputRoot.JSON.Data.invoice.taxNumber. This throws when the field does not exist.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I have looked at the error in the message flow log. The ESQL compute node is trying to read a 'taxNumber' field from the incoming invoice JSON, but this field does not exist in the payload from this particular supplier. The code does not have a null check for this field, so it throws an error when the field is missing. I have two options: add a null check in the ESQL so it handles missing tax numbers gracefully, or ask the supplier to always include the field. Which approach do you...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: We cannot change the supplier's invoice format - they are a large partner. We need to handle the missing field on our side.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Understood. I will add a null check so the field defaults to an empty string when absent. Before I make this change, could you send me 2-3 sample invoice payloads from this supplier so I can test the fix against their actual data format? I want to make sure there are no other missing fields we need to handle.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I will ask the supplier to send sample payloads. Will get back to you by end of today.
